summary.text: Francis "Topper" McFaun, a Republican from Barre Town, represented Washington-Orange in the Vermont House of Representatives, with service from 2005 until he resigned on April 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: McFaun was born in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and has lived in Barre Town since 1967, according to his House biography.
He earned a BS in education from Boston University in 1963 and took graduate courses at Boston College, Harvard University and the University of Vermont.
He retired after 38 years of employment with Vermont state government.
He is a past president and board member of the Central Vermont Economic Development Corporation and Central Vermont Home Health and Hospice.
